thank you

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: I need a little of your help
parts:
The default histogram *does* plot the counts. Reproducible example:

df <- data.frame(x = rnorm(100))
qplot(x, data = df, geom = 'histogram')
ggplot(df, aes(x)) + geom_histogram()

Both of them plot counts rather than percentages or densities.

Dennis
